{{Spell InfoBox|image=Floating_Wisp.png|desc=Long-lasting floating fireball|type=Spell Projectiles|rarity=Normal|mana_cost1=9|mana_cost2=12|mana_cost3=15|dmg1=30|dmg2=54|dmg3=98|crit_rate1=20%|crit_rate2=20%|crit_rate3=20%|scatter1=30°|scatter2=45°|scatter3=60°|misc_a_1=Attract nearby wisps upon hitting enemies|misc_a_2=Attract nearby wisps upon hitting enemies|misc_b_2=Self-replicate every 4 seconds when wisps present|misc_a_3=Attract nearby wisps upon hitting enemies|misc_b_3=Self-replicate every 3 seconds when wisps present}}The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Rarity|Normal]] [[Spells|Spell]] of [[Spell Types|Type]]: Spell Projectiles. When the default spell is cast, a wisp hovers out near the player.

'''Description:''' A hovering fire ball made up of magical creatures, they are good at working together and gather other wisps to support them when they find their target.

After upgrading, these magical creatures will multiply at a higher rate, constantly generating new wisps.
